# The component library

Generated from the `plugins/` tree, so it cannot drift from what the repo ships. Versions are the
per-component `<name>-version` markers that `forge-adapt drift` compares against; see
[docs/guides/versioning.md](guides/versioning.md).

Each name links to the component's source file. For what each plugin group installs and needs,
see [plugins.md](plugins.md).
